summary:
ITER 179 — Financial Model: Template + Excel/Google-Sheet Import + IIMB Valuation tab. ALL GREEN. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter179_fm_iimb_imports.py. Frontend (mobile 390x844 via https://modal-responsive-fix.preview.emergentagent.com): every new review-request testID renders, the Google-Sheet import modal opens, the WACC=CAPM toggle reveals the CAPM fields, and the new Valuation (IIMB) tab renders WACC build-up + NOPLAT→FCFF bridge + Market-EV cross-checks with live numbers.

BACKEND DETAIL (super@test.com via /api/auth/login → session_token):
  • GET /api/financial-models/templates/inputs.xlsx → 200, Content-Type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, Content-Disposition attachment; filename="financial-model-template.xlsx"; openpyxl-parsable; column-A labels include 'Year-1 revenue', 'Gross margin %', 'WACC %', 'Beta', 'Market risk premium %', 'Cost of debt %', 'Risk-free rate %' ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/import-file (filled template via chunked upload /api/uploads/init + /api/uploads/chunk with chunk_b64): 200 → {patch, found}; patch.year1_revenue=12,000,000, patch.gross_margin_pct=55, patch.wacc_pct=18, patch.revenue_by_year=[10M,15M,22M,30M,40M] (length 5) ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/import-file with a non-template .xlsx (garbage column-A labels) → 422 ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/import-sheet with empty URL or 'https://example.com/not-a-sheet' → 422 'Paste a valid Google Sheets link.' ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/import-sheet with a well-formed docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<id>/edit URL → id-parser ACCEPTS it (does not return 'Paste a valid Google Sheets link.'); subsequent fetch failure surfaces as a different 4xx — confirms gsheet_id_and_gid parser correctly extracts the id ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/compute now includes the 'iimb' block with every required field: cost_of_equity_pct, equity_weight_pct, debt_weight_pct, wacc_capm_pct, wacc_used_pct, noplat[], gross_cash_flow[], increase_in_nwc[], fcff[], pv_fcff[], enterprise_value, equity_value, per_share, simple_market_ev, fuller_market_ev (all year-lists length 5) ✓.
  • CAPM math verified with rf=7%, β=1.2, MRP=6%, kd=10%, tax=25%, mkt_cap=50M, open_debt=2M: Ke = 7+1.2×6 = 14.2% ✓; weights 96.15% / 3.85% ✓; kd-after-tax = 7.5%; wacc_capm ≈ 13.94% ✓; in wacc_mode='capm' iimb.wacc_used_pct == iimb.wacc_capm_pct == valuation.wacc_pct ✓.
  • In wacc_mode='direct' with wacc_pct=18, iimb.wacc_used_pct ≈ 18 and is clearly different from iimb.wacc_capm_pct ✓.
  • iimb.fcff equals valuation.fcff list-for-list ✓.
  • Market-EV: simple_market_ev = mkt_cap + (open_debt − open_cash) = 50M + (2M − 7M) = 45M ✓; fuller_market_ev = mkt_cap + open_debt + minority + pref − cash − non_op = 50M + 2M + 1M + 0.5M − 7M − 0.2M = 46.3M ✓.

FRONTEND DETAIL (mobile 390x844, super@test.com session token injected to localStorage, deep-link to /tools/financial-model?org=<seeded c79…>&goal=<L1>):
  • Inputs tab buttons (new): fm-template-dl ✓, fm-import-xls ✓, fm-import-sheet ✓.
  • WACC source toggle: fm-wacc-direct ✓ and fm-wacc-capm ✓. Tapping CAPM keeps fm-beta visible.
  • New CAPM inputs render: fm-risk_free_pct ✓, fm-beta ✓, fm-market_risk_premium_pct ✓, fm-cost_of_debt_pct ✓, fm-market_cap ✓.
  • Tapping fm-import-sheet opens the 'Import from Google Sheet' modal with fm-sheet-url ✓ and fm-sheet-import ✓; entering a bad URL fires a request that returns 422 (visible in console as 'Failed to load resource: 422') — wiring confirmed.
  • New 'Valuation (IIMB)' tab (fm-tab-iimb) is present ✓; after Recalculate it renders without crashing and shows: Enterprise Value ₹41,722,114, Equity Value ₹46,722,114, Per-Share ₹58.4; full WACC build-up panel (Ke=13.6%, Kd pre-tax=12%, Kd after-tax=9%, E/V=70%, D/V=30%, WACC CAPM=12.22%, WACC used in DCF=12.22%); full NOPLAT→FCFF bridge table for Y1..Y5; Market-EV cross-checks (Simple EV, Fuller EV). No error elements in DOM.
  • Regression: fm-tab-pnl / fm-tab-bs / fm-tab-cf / fm-tab-ratios / fm-tab-valuation all still clickable; fm-recalc, fm-save, fm-seed all still present.

No new Expo/RN deprecation warnings beyond the chronic shadow*/pointerEvents/TouchableWithoutFeedback/expo-notifications-web warnings already tracked in prior iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: core/fin_template.py — clean: label normalization is whitespace+punctuation-insensitive (re.sub('[^a-z0-9]','')), so users can re-paste rows into Sheets without breaking. TEMPLATE_FIELDS contains all CAPM fields (risk_free, beta, MRP, kd, market_cap) so a single download/import round-trip drives both direct-WACC and CAPM-build-up modes.

core/fin_model.py — IIMB block is internally consistent: noplat = ebit×(1−tax), gross_cash_flow = noplat + dep, fcff = noplat + dep − capex − ΔWC, and increase_in_nwc is back-derived (noplat + dep − capex − fcff) so it matches FCFF exactly. wacc_mode='capm' switches the DCF to CAPM WACC; valuation.wacc_pct mirrors iimb.wacc_used_pct.

routes/financial_model.py — import-file uses the same chunked-upload + assemble pattern as the rest of the app; import-sheet falls back from public CSV → user's Google credentials → 403 with a clear message. The id parser cleanly rejects non-sheet URLs with 422 'Paste a valid Google Sheets link.' before any network call.

frontend/app/tools/financial-model.tsx — all new testIDs (fm-template-dl/fm-import-xls/fm-import-sheet/fm-wacc-direct/fm-wacc-capm/fm-risk_free_pct/fm-beta/fm-market_risk_premium_pct/fm-cost_of_debt_pct/fm-market_cap/fm-sheet-url/fm-sheet-import/fm-tab-iimb) wired; CAPM build-up section is inside the Inputs tab; IIMB tab pulls computed.iimb safely.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every new review-request testID present (20/20), CAPM toggle reveals CAPM fields, sheet modal opens with URL+Import buttons, Valuation (IIMB) tab renders WACC build-up + NOPLAT→FCFF bridge + Market-EV cross-checks with live numbers, no console error elements
